title: 前序与中序遍历
full_code:
class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, value, left=None, right=None):
        self.value = value
        self.left = left
        self.right = right

def preorder(node, out=None):
    out = out if out is not None else []
    if node:
        out.append(node.value)
        preorder(node.left, out)
        preorder(node.right, out)
    return out

def inorder(node, out=None):
    out = out if out is not None else []
    if node:
        inorder(node.left, out)
        out.append(node.value)
        inorder(node.right, out)
    return out

root = TreeNode(1, TreeNode(2, TreeNode(4)), TreeNode(3))
print("前序:", preorder(root))
print("中序:", inorder(root))

points.hint: 💡 前序顺序：根、左、右
💡 中序顺序：左、根、右

hints.level_2: 📖 二叉树递归套路；BST 中序有序；堆是完全二叉树；Trie 按字符分叉
hints.level_4:
📝 正确答案：`out.append(node.value)
        preorder(node.left, out)`；`inorder(node.left, out)`

explanation: 三种遍历只差『访问根』的位置。递归写法简洁；面试常考非递归（显式栈）版本。

title: 翻转二叉树
description: 递归交换每个节点的左右子树
full_code:
class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, value, left=None, right=None):
        self.value = value
        self.left = left
        self.right = right

def preorder(node, out=None):
    out = out if out is not None else []
    if node:
        out.append(node.value)
        preorder(node.left, out)
        preorder(node.right, out)
    return out

def invert(node):
    if node is None:
        return None
    node.left, node.right = invert(node.right), invert(node.left)
    return node

root = TreeNode(1, TreeNode(2, TreeNode(4)), TreeNode(3))
mirrored = invert(root)
print("新左子树根:", mirrored.left.value)
print("前序:", preorder(mirrored))

points.hint: 💡 先递归翻转两边再交换
💡 每个节点都返回自己作为子树根

hints.level_1: 💡 先递归翻转两边再交换
hints.level_2: 📖 二叉树递归套路；BST 中序有序；堆是完全二叉树；Trie 按字符分叉
hints.level_3: 👀 接近答案：`node.left, node.right = invert(node.righ`、`return node`
hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：`node.left, node.right = invert(node.right), invert(node.left)`；`return node`

explanation: 翻转=先翻转左右子树再交换指针。先交换再递归也对——后序与先序只是实现顺序不同。
